title: nbn service disruption - Wodonga, VIC
current_summary:
Affects some nbn services in the Wodonga, VIC area. The issue was reported at 4:09 am AEDT on 15 November 2026, and no restoration estimate has been provided yet.

nbn is working hard to resolve an unexpected network issue in your area causing a partial or total loss of connectivity to your nbn service. Using mobile data can help you stay connected if needed.
